aliases: itr json: balance sheet, trading account

params.name: form_items
params.label: a form with its own layout (ITR-6, Schedule III): its items' paths - used instead of items + rewrites

params.name: form_checks
params.label: that form's two checks (and the business-profit row's words)

description_nl: SF Ref 'ITR3 BS debtors' or 'ITR3 PL salaries' puts a row's amount on that item; rows on one item add up. Then the totals are worked out in this order (each = its plus items less its minus items). Two checks ride with the export: the balance sheet's sources against its application, and the P&L's profit before tax against the 'Net profit as per P&L' row mapped to business income. Paths are the ITR-3 schema's; 'rewrites' turn them into another form's names (ITR-5: partners' fund, debtor / creditor details, P&L debits under DebitPlAcnt) - and a path a schema still does not have is skipped and named. 2026-10-11: ITR-6: a company's balance sheet and P&L in the Schedule III layout (Part A-BS For6, Trading / Manufacturing account, Part A-P&L) - its own items (the same item names as ITR-3 / ITR-5, so the same suggestions and refs work, plus share capital, securities premium, director loans, current maturities, CSR expenditure, the manufacturing account's raw material and WIP), totals in order, and the two checks: equity and liabilities = total assets; the P&L's profit before tax = the computation statement's profit-before-tax row. Rows on one path add up.
